profile.headline: Software Engineer | Product Strategy & Technical Delivery | UI/UX Design
profile.summary:
I’m a technical professional with 5+ years of experience in frontend engineering, UI/UX, product development, and project delivery. I enjoy solving problems by building beautiful, intuitive digital experiences, improving cross-functional coordination, connecting systems through APIs, streamlining technical processes, and delivering impactful products.

Throughout my career, I’ve led and contributed to software engineering and digital product initiatives involving:
• Building and improving web applications with a focus on performance, usability, and maintainability
• Translating product requirements and user needs into functional workflows, practical solutions, and intuitive digital experiences
• Coordinating requirements, priorities, dependencies, milestones, and releases to move technical initiatives from planning through delivery
• Integrating REST APIs and improving engineering workflows to increase team productivity and collaboration
• Collaborating across teams, including engineering, design, and business stakeholders, to clarify requirements, coordinate releases, troubleshoot issues, and deliver reliable software
• Improving documentation and development standards, reviewing code, and supporting junior engineers
• Exploring AI-assisted workflows for research, technical problem-solving, planning, and software development

Currently, I’m building independent software projects that combine software engineering, product development, UI/UX, and AI-assisted workflows.

Beyond technology, I enjoy pickleball, traveling, films, music, and health & wellness.

positions.title: Beauty Advisor | Laura Mercier, Impulse Beauty, Clinique
positions.description:
• Collaborated with managers and associates for cosmetics pre-selling and sales driven events to maximize sales.
• Executed excellent product knowledge to customers based on their personal features and needs for a customized experience.
• Transformed disorganized cosmetics stock room and counter by redesigning the layout to reduce stock shortage. 
• Drove sales by demonstrating exceptional selling skills, ensuring the customers are always the first priority.
• Co-ordinated and managed events to grow revenue and build brand awareness.
• Assisted in developing marketing materials targeting new business and to expand client base.
• Demonstrated commitment and the ability to build customer relationships and loyalty through personal interaction and maintenance of client files. 
• Increased brand integrity and awareness by keeping track of quality marketing content.
• Achieved 116% presell goal for fall '15 GWP.
• Developed and implemented business-driving events with Counter Manager to ensure proper execution to achieve counter productivity goals.
• Performed sales support functions related to POS procedures.
• Ensured proper presentation, organization, storing, and replenishment of stock.

positions.description:

• Curated consistent, on-brand, and original content to build brand awareness, increase site traffic, and grow organically.
• Changed social media editorial calendars and schedules by updating content on a consistent basis for upcoming viral trends.
• Summarized weekly and monthly reports across social media platforms for analysis.
